evals.name: links-written-as-reference-links
evals.prompt: /ideate 根据 docs/ideas/idea.md 整理产品构想
evals.expected_output: The original idea.md confirms every required field and gives 4 URLs plus one local research note cited by both research targets. Rewrites docs/ideas/idea.md where every link is a reference link (collapsed `[text][]` unless link texts collide), no label is defined twice, the research note is defined once, definitions sit at the file end after `---` grouped under HTML comments (local file group first, then URL groups), and each research item carries a 调研记录 line.
expectations: Both research items have a `调研记录：` line pointing to the same reference
Definitions are at the end of idea.md, local file group before URL groups, each under an HTML comment
Every reference link has exactly one definition and every definition is referenced
No label is defined twice, and every link resolves to its URL from the original idea.md
Only the URLs from the original idea.md appear; no searched or guessed links are added

evals.name: no-links-no-definition-block
evals.prompt: /ideate 根据 docs/ideas/idea.md 整理产品构想
evals.expected_output: The original idea.md confirms every required field, no research and no technical references. Rewrites idea.md with `> 无` under sections 3 and 4 and leaves out the link definitions block entirely.
expectations: idea.md has no link definition lines and no link-group HTML comments
idea.md has no leftover template placeholders such as `<链接文本>` or `<URL>`
